free_tier.stated: Unlimited total storage on the free 普通版: '无限制的总存储空间，分享免登录，不限制下载流量，不限速，不限制下载次数'. Per-file cap is the binding constraint, and it is tier-set in 个人中心 → 文件升级.

per_object_cap.stated: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB

egress.terms: Explicitly unmetered: no download traffic limit, no speed limit, no download-count limit, and shares download without login.

tooling: No official API. Community wrappers exist (lanzou uploader scripts, `lanzou-api` style repos); the browser upload form is the only documented path.
chaining: Registration needs a mainland phone number, so chaining is bounded by SIM supply, not by quota.

limits.value: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB

limits_note: Per-file cap widely reported at 100 MB for free (raised per-account via the 文件升级 setting; Share links are public by design. Registration requires 手机号 + SMS code.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: r, which is the hardest registration gate in this slot. No API means any large-scale use depends on an unofficial wrapper that breaks when the web form changes. Unlimited total x 100

reliability_note: Registration is SMS-gated on a Chinese mobile number, which is the hardest registration gate in this slot. No API means any large-scale use depends on an unofficial wrapper that breaks when the web form changes.
